label: Step 9 decision rules
declared: 2026-10-15, before any decision run or evaluation. Values chosen from physical reasoning (below), not from results; to be reviewed by the project owner. Any later change must be disclosed in the README.
changes_after_replay_demo: 2026-10-15, after the Capture_2 replay demo and before any evaluation; design decisions by the project owner, not tuning:
look_ahead added: rule 1 applies only inside the stop zone (corridor within look_ahead_m ahead); rule 2 predicts entry into the stop zone. Before: rule 1 used the whole corridor ahead.
load changed from a 0.70 m tray to a centred Euro pallet (0.80 m across travel): required width 0.90 -> 1.00 m.
one required width (footprint.load_footprint from robot.json and the load file it names); paths.load_config removed; the corridor width must equal it.

look_ahead.formula: look_ahead_m = v * reaction_s + v^2 / (2 * decel) + buffer_m
look_ahead.check: footprint.look_ahead recomputes look_ahead_m from robot.json and these inputs and refuses a mismatch; the engine refuses caution_ahead_m < look_ahead_m.

why.look_ahead: Owner's decision: reaction distance (1.0 m/s * 0.5 s = 0.5 m) + braking distance (1.0^2 / (2 * 0.5) = 1.0 m) + 1.5 m buffer = 3.0 m. A person beyond it is far enough for the robot to stop after detecting them inside it.
why.motion_range_m: Decided before Step 9: the motion operating range. Step 8 was evaluated in the 0-3 m and 3-6 m bins; beyond 6 m motion counts as unknown.
why.entry_horizon_s: A walking person (1.4 m/s) covers about 4 m in 3 s, more than the 3 m caution distance, so a crossing person is stopped for before reaching the stop zone. Shorter than the Step 8 route horizon (5 s), because constant-velocity prediction degrades with look-ahead.
why.entry_time_step_s: 0.05 s at 1.4 m/s is 7 cm per step, well under the corridor half-width.
why.caution_lateral_m: One arm's length plus a step beside the corridor edge: a person this close can enter the corridor in under 1 s.
why.caution_ahead_m: Distance the robot would cover in about 3 s at 1 m/s; within the 0-3 m bin where Step 8 motion is best characterised. Must be >= look_ahead_m (equal at the declared values).
why.person_memory_s: A tracked person whose position drops out (occlusion, invalid depth) keeps its latest valid position for 1 s, which is longer than resume_hold_s, so a brief dropout cannot release a STOP on its own.
why.unlocated_person_in_caution_zone: A person detected without a usable position counts as in the caution zone unless its distance_m is beyond caution_ahead_m. distance_m comes from the person provider: in the THUD replay, Step 8 distance_m = ground distance from camera_proxy to the median of the valid-depth pixels selected for the track, available even when position_valid is false. It is a median, not a lower bound (see README).
why.gesture_min_confidence: Gesture-module outputs below this count as NONE. To be checked against the gesture module's own operating point when the adapter exists.
why.stop_hold_frames: Three consecutive gesture frames rejects single-frame flicker while adding only a few frames of delay to a STOP.
why.move_hold_s: MOVE needs a deliberate gesture: longer than STOP because releasing the robot is the riskier direction.
why.gesture_timeout_s: A gesture not refreshed for 0.5 s is no longer being shown.
why.resume_hold_s: Asymmetric timing: STOP is immediate; MOVE (from any non-MOVE state, including the first start) needs the rule-7 conditions to hold continuously for 1 s.

conventions: Corridor: centreline in travel order, width = required_width_m (footprint.load_footprint); only the part from the robot's projected position onwards counts (robot_xz unknown -> from the start of the line).
Stop zone: the corridor from the robot's projected position to look_ahead_m ahead, flat at the far end.

Caution zone: outside the stop zone, within caution_lateral_m of the corridor edge, up to caution_ahead_m ahead (flat far end). With caution_ahead_m = look_ahead_m it contains no corridor beyond the stop zone.

Rule 2 prediction: constant person velocity against the current stop zone; robot motion is covered by look_ahead_m. Covers sideways entry and head-on approach; the reason reports the gap and the closing speed (gap / time to entry).
Trusted motion: motion_trusted, a motion label other than unknown / insufficient_history, a velocity, a current position and distance_m <= motion_range_m. Otherwise motion counts as unknown.
Any current STOP gesture (accepted or not yet) cancels every MOVE gesture, so a STOP from one person always overrides a MOVE from another.
Passage: a 'clear' status without a width, or with a width below required_width_m, is treated as unknown / too_narrow; a passage evaluated for a different required width is treated as unknown.

Step 8 route fields (route_label, route_status, dist_to_route_centreline_m, time_to_route_*, p_enter_route_within_horizon) and the proxy_route width_m are proxies and are not read by decisions; decisions read only the proxy_route centreline.
